name: EcomXray
summary: Shows cost price, gross margin, current stock and net units sold over 30, 90 and 365 days for every Shopify product, with restock advice from real sales velocity.
best_for: small and mid-size Shopify merchants who want cost price, gross margin, clean net unit sales and restock advice inside the admin instead of exporting to a spreadsheet
skip_if: you sell across several channels and need cross-platform inventory sync, you already run a dedicated inventory or MRP system, or you want an app with a public track record longer than a month
honest_knock:
The split between the two tiers is unusually clean, and worth seeing clearly: everything this app is described as doing, the margins, the net units, the restock advice, is free. The $29 buys editing, not insight. If you are happy making changes in the Shopify admin you already have, the free plan is the whole product and the paid one is a convenience layer over it.

The track record is the real caveat, and it has not moved. The app launched on 20 July 2026 and still had no reviews at all when we checked on 8 September, seven weeks later. Nothing is known about how it behaves at scale, how it handles a catalogue in the tens of thousands, or how quickly support answers, because nobody has said so in public.

And its numbers are only as good as your cost prices. Gross margin comes out of Shopify's own cost-per-item field, so if that field is empty or stale across your catalogue, the margin column is decoration. Fill the cost prices in first, then judge the app.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pro · per month for in-place product editing, SEO fields and automatic redirects, publishing to channels, the full activity log and the Chrome extension, with a 14-day free trial
pricing.notes: (re-verified 21 November 2026 on apps.shopify.com/ecomxray; unchanged since 21 August 2026) Two tiers. Free: product analytics inside Shopify, cost price and gross margin, net units sold over 30, 90 and 365 days with refunds, cancellations and test orders excluded, 30-day restock recommendations and a revenue rank for top products. Pro is $29 a month, with a 14-day free trial. It carries everything in Free plus editing product name, description and price in place, SEO fields with automatic URL redirects, publishing to channels and managing collections. There is also a full product activity log, and a Chrome extension showing stock value and editing on your storefront product pages. There is no annual rate on the listing. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Developer aMemory ApS, Ellegardvej 36, Sonderborg, Denmark; the app launched 20 July 2026 and, four months on, still carries a 0.0 rating from zero reviews. The listing's own summary bullets put in-place editing and the audit log among the app's five headline features without marking them Pro, which is the one place the listing reads as more generous than the plan table it sits above.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested EcomXray on a Shopify development store on the Free plan: the install, Product Analytics for two products (about 3 minutes and 4 steps after the install), which showed Cost price Not set, Gross margin N/A and Suggested reorder 0 units because the store has no cost prices and no sales, the app plan page with Free and Pro at $29 a month, and the Shopify plan screen where Pro was Unavailable on dev stores. No Shopify approval screen was reached and nothing was paid. The margin, units sold and restock advice were not tested with data and the Pro functions were not tested. The app was uninstalled afterwards. Install: the install form on the App Store page was submitted in our own tab at 17:33; the dialog Install app asked for View customer data (device and activity data), View staff and contributor data (store owner) and View and edit store data (products, orders, other data), and Install was clicked. At about 17:35 the app was open with a banner that said it is active on the store and that Product Analytics in the left menu needs no browser extension. The app was on the Free plan at once, with no plan choice and no separate registration. The admin was in English. Core action, reading the product analytics: Product Analytics, choose Selling Plans Ski Wax (about 17:37, 4 steps, about 3 minutes after the install). The page showed Sell price 24.95 USD, Cost price Not set, Gross margin N/A, a warning that the cost price is not set for this variant so margin, profit and stock value cannot be calculated until a unit cost is added in Shopify, Current stock 10 units, Current stock value N/A, Days of stock left No recent sales, Average daily sales (30d) 0.00/day, Suggested reorder 0 units, Restock status No recent sales and 0 units sold. The product The 3p Fulfilled Snowboard (2629.95 USD, 20 units, sku-hosted-1) showed the same warning and margin N/A. So the app works as far as it can on a store with no cost prices and no sales for these products, and it told us exactly what was missing; but the margin calculation with a filled-in cost price, the units sold with real orders and the restock advice with a sales history were NOT tested with data. Plans: the app page Your plan shows Free (Product analytics inside Shopify; Cost price and gross margin; Net units sold 30 / 90 / 365 days; 30-day restock recommendations; Revenue rank for top products) and Pro at $29 a month (Everything in Free; Edit product name, description and prices; SEO fields and automatic URL redirects; Publish to sales channels and manage collections; Full product activity log; an optional Chrome Extension with stock value and advanced editing; 14-day free trial) with a button Start 14-day free trial. The Shopify screen Select a plan says in the section Free to test that these plans are free to test on this store and that regular pricing applies when the store goes live, with the Free plan and a Select button, and in the section Unavailable on dev stores that these plans can't be selected while the store is in development: Pro at $29 / 30 days with 14 trial days and a greyed out button Not available. Differences with the dossier: none found. Pro at $29 a month with a 14-day free trial, billed every 30 days, and the features of Free and Pro are those of the dossier. Checkout: NOT reached. Pro cannot be selected on a development store, so the Shopify screen Approve subscription never appeared, no test charge text was seen and nothing was approved or billed. Cancelling: no paid plan was started, so nothing could be cancelled. The way to stop is to uninstall: Settings, Apps, the three dots menu, Uninstall opens Uninstall EcomXray? with the text that you can no longer use the app and that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, that a request is sent to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information, and a required reason (we chose Testing multiple apps). Not tested: the Pro functions (editing, SEO fields and redirects, publishing to channels, the activity log and the Chrome extension, which cannot be chosen on a development store), the margin with a cost price, units sold with real orders, restock advice with a sales history, and multichannel stock sync (not offered). No theme change was made and nothing was changed in the store. Clean up: the app was uninstalled through Settings, Apps and disappeared from Installed (the notes give 17:4x for it); our own tab was closed. The clock times in the notes can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The analytics could not show a margin, a stock value or a restock advice because the store has no cost prices and no sales, Pro cannot be selected on a development store so no approval screen was seen, and the app page and the Shopify plan screen give two different looks at the same two plans.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested EcomXray on a Shopify development store on the Free plan: the install, Product Analytics for two products (about 3 minutes and 4 steps after the install), which showed Cost price Not set, Gross margin N/A and Suggested reorder 0 units because the store has no cost prices and no sales, the app plan page with Free and Pro at $29 a month, and the Shopify plan screen where Pro was Unavailable on dev stores. No Shopify approval screen was reached and nothing was paid. The margin, units sold and restock advice were not tested with data and the Pro functions were not tested. The app was uninstalled afterwards. Install: the install form on the App Store page was submitted in our own tab at 17:33; the dialog Install app asked for View customer data (device and activity data), View staff and contributor data (store owner) and View and edit store data (products, orders, other data), and Install was clicked. At about 17:35 the app was open with a banner that said it is active on the store and that Product Analytics in the left menu needs no browser extension. The app was on the Free plan at once, with no plan choice and no separate registration. The admin was in English. Core action, reading the product analytics: Product Analytics, choose Selling Plans Ski Wax (about 17:37, 4 steps, about 3 minutes after the install). The page showed Sell price 24.95 USD, Cost price Not set, Gross margin N/A, a warning that the cost price is not set for this variant so margin, profit and stock value cannot be calculated until a unit cost is added in Shopify, Current stock 10 units, Current stock value N/A, Days of stock left No recent sales, Average daily sales (30d) 0.00/day, Suggested reorder 0 units, Restock status No recent sales and 0 units sold. The product The 3p Fulfilled Snowboard (2629.95 USD, 20 units, sku-hosted-1) showed the same warning and margin N/A. So the app works as far as it can on a store with no cost prices and no sales for these products, and it told us exactly what was missing; but the margin calculation with a filled-in cost price, the units sold with real orders and the restock advice with a sales history were NOT tested with data. Plans: the app page Your plan shows Free (Product analytics inside Shopify; Cost price and gross margin; Net units sold 30 / 90 / 365 days; 30-day restock recommendations; Revenue rank for top products) and Pro at $29 a month (Everything in Free; Edit product name, description and prices; SEO fields and automatic URL redirects; Publish to sales channels and manage collections; Full product activity log; an optional Chrome Extension with stock value and advanced editing; 14-day free trial) with a button Start 14-day free trial. The Shopify screen Select a plan says in the section Free to test that these plans are free to test on this store and that regular pricing applies when the store goes live, with the Free plan and a Select button, and in the section Unavailable on dev stores that these plans can't be selected while the store is in development: Pro at $29 / 30 days with 14 trial days and a greyed out button Not available. Differences with the dossier: none found. Pro at $29 a month with a 14-day free trial, billed every 30 days, and the features of Free and Pro are those of the dossier. Checkout: NOT reached. Pro cannot be selected on a development store, so the Shopify screen Approve subscription never appeared, no test charge text was seen and nothing was approved or billed. Cancelling: no paid plan was started, so nothing could be cancelled. The way to stop is to uninstall: Settings, Apps, the three dots menu, Uninstall opens Uninstall EcomXray? with the text that you can no longer use the app and that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, that a request is sent to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information, and a required reason (we chose Testing multiple apps). Not tested: the Pro functions (editing, SEO fields and redirects, publishing to channels, the activity log and the Chrome extension, which cannot be chosen on a development store), the margin with a cost price, units sold with real orders, restock advice with a sales history, and multichannel stock sync (not offered). No theme change was made and nothing was changed in the store. Clean up: the app was uninstalled through Settings, Apps and disappeared from Installed (the notes give 17:4x for it); our own tab was closed. The clock times in the notes can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The analytics could not show a margin, a stock value or a restock advice because the store has no cost prices and no sales, Pro cannot be selected on a development store so no approval screen was seen, and the app page and the Shopify plan screen give two different looks at the same two plans.
